analytics.title: Marketing analytics
analytics.subtitle: Which campaigns earned the conversions, what the customers they brought in are worth, and where people drop out of the funnel.
analytics.model_help_first_touch: All the credit goes to the campaign that introduced the customer. This is what CRM records show.
analytics.model_help_last_touch: All the credit goes to the last campaign touched before the conversion.
analytics.model_help_linear: Credit is shared equally across every campaign touched on the way.
analytics.model_help_time_decay: Touches closer to the conversion get more credit: a touch loses half its weight every {days} days.
analytics.model_help_position_based: 40% to the first touch, 40% to the last, and 20% shared across the touches in between.
analytics.nothing_attributed: No conversions or won deals were recorded in this period.
analytics.comparison_help: Credited revenue per campaign under each model (conversions · ROAS below). The selected model is highlighted.
analytics.ltv_help: Customers acquired in the period (first won deal), credited to the campaign that introduced them. Lifetime revenue is every won deal to date; CAC is the period's spend divided by customers acquired.
analytics.no_customers: No customer acquired in this period can be traced to a campaign yet.
analytics.cohorts_help: Customers grouped by the month of their first won deal, with the revenue they brought in each month after it.
analytics.funnel_help: Impressions and clicks come from the networks; leads and deals are the CRM records created in the period that carry a campaign. Percentages are step conversion rates.
